mn74:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate sūkarakhatāyaṃ.
mn74:2.1: atha kho dīghanakho paribbājako yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi,
mn74:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho dīghanakho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn74:2.3: ahaṃ hi bho gotama evaṃ vādī evaṃdiṭṭhi,
mn74:2.5: yāpi kho te esā aggivessana diṭṭhi
mn74:2.6: sabbaṃ me na khamatīti, esāpi te diṭṭhi na khamatīti.
mn74:2.7: esā ce me bho gotama diṭṭhi khameyya tampassa tādisameva, tampassa tādisamevāti.
mn74:3.1: ato kho te aggivessana bahūhi bahutarā lokasmiṃ ye evamāhaṃsu:
mn74:3.3: te tañceva diṭṭhiṃ nappajahanti, aññañca diṭṭhiṃ upādiyanti.
mn74:3.4: ato kho te aggivessana tanūhi tanutarā lokasmiṃ ye evamāhaṃsu:
mn74:3.6: te tañceva diṭṭhiṃ pajahanti, aññañca diṭṭhiṃ na upādiyanti.

mn74:5.1: evaṃ vutte dīghanakho paribbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn74:5.2: ukkaṃsati me bhavaṃ gotamo diṭṭhigataṃ samukkaṃsati me bhavaṃ gotamo diṭṭhigata’nti.
mn74:5.3: tatraggivessana ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino:
mn74:5.4: ekaccaṃ me khamati, ekaccaṃ me na khamatī’ti.
mn74:5.5: yā hi kho nesaṃ khamati sāyaṃ diṭṭhi sārāgāya santike, saṃyogāya santike, abhinandanāya santike, ajjhosānāya santike, upādānāya santike.
mn74:5.6: yāhi kho tesaṃ na khamati sāyaṃ diṭṭhi asārāgāya santike asaṃyogāya santike anabhinandanāya santike anajjhosānāya santike anupādānāya santike.
mn74:6.1: tatraggivessana ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino
mn74:6.6: imañce ahaṃ diṭṭhiṃ thāmasā parāmassa abhinivissa vohareyyaṃ:
mn74:6.9: yo cāyaṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi: sabbaṃ me na khamatīti.
mn74:6.10: yocāyaṃ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā evaṃvādī evaṃdiṭṭhi: ekaccaṃ me khamati, ekaccaṃ me na khamatī’ti.
mn74:6.12: iti viggahe sati vivādo, vivāde sati vighāto, vighāte sati vihesā.
mn74:6.13: iti so viggahañca vivādañca vighātañca vihesañca attani sampassamāno tañceva diṭṭhiṃ pajahati. aññañca diṭṭhiṃ na upādiyati.
mn74:6.14: evametāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ pahānaṃ hoti. evametāsaṃ diṭṭhīnaṃ paṭinissaggo hoti.

mn74:9.1: ayaṃ kho panaggivessana kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummāsupacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo, aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassitabbo.
mn74:9.2: tassimaṃ kāyaṃ aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassato yo kāyasmiṃ kāyacchando kāyasneho kāyanvayatā sā pahīyati.
mn74:10.2: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
mn74:10.3: yasmiṃ aggivessana samaye sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. neva tasmiṃ samaye dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti. na adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti.
mn74:10.5: yasmiṃ aggivessana samaye dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti, neva tasmiṃ samaye sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti, na adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti,
mn74:10.7: yasmiṃ aggivessana samaye adukkhamasukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti, neva tasmiṃ samaye sukhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti, na dukkhaṃ vedanaṃ vedeti.
mn74:11.1: sukhāpi kho aggivessana vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā,
mn74:11.2: dukkhāpi kho aggivessana vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā,
mn74:11.3: adukkhamasukhāpi kho aggivessana vedanā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā khayadhammā vayadhammā virāgadhammā nirodhadhammā.
mn74:12.1: evaṃ passaṃ aggivessana sutavā ariyasāvako sukhāyapi vedanāya nibbindati, dukkhāyapi vedanāya nibbindati, adukkhamasukhāyapi vedanāya nibbindati.
mn74:12.2: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
mn74:12.3: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn74:13.1: evaṃ vimuttacitto kho aggivessana bhikkhu na kenaci saṃvadati. na kenaci vivadati. yañca loke vuttaṃ teneva voharati aparāmasanti.
mn74:14.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sāriputto bhagavato piṭṭhito ṭhito hoti bhagavantaṃ vijayamāno.
mn74:14.3: tesaṃ tesaṃ kira no bhagavā dhammānaṃ abhiññā pahāṇamāha. tesaṃ tesaṃ kira no sugato dhammānaṃ abhiññā paṭinissaggamāhāti.
mn74:14.4: iti’hidaṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa paṭisañcikkhato anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci.
mn74:15.1: dīghanakhassa pana paribbājakassa virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
mn74:15.2: yaṃ kiñci samudaya dhammaṃ, sabbantaṃ nirodhadhammanti.
mn74:15.3: atha kho dīghanakho paribbājako diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṅkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn74:16.1: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho gotama.
mn74:16.2: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti. evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn74:16.3: esāhaṃ bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn74:16.4: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
